note: Frontier log: dated releases, published results and shipped capabilities in AI, chips, robotics and autonomy. One entry per release; the run appends and never edits. kind = model|chip|robot|autonomy|result|tool.

releases.t: Tesla runs unsupervised robotaxi rides in Fort Worth
releases.n: Tesla's Robotaxi service began fully unsupervised public rides in Fort Worth, Texas, at 06:00 local time on 2 Nov, with no safety monitor on board, using Model Y cars across about 143 square miles. Fort Worth is the seventh unsupervised city after Austin, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Orlando and Tampa; fleet size and fares were not published.
src: Tesla expands Robotaxi service, launches unsupervised rides in Fort Worth

releases.t: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5: 1.6 trillion parameters, 48 billion active
releases.n: Meituan released LongCat-2.5 on 2 Nov, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 1.6 trillion total parameters and about 48 billion active per token, built for long agent runs over whole codebases. It is live in Meituan's chat service and API; open weights on GitHub and Hugging Face are promised but not yet out, and no benchmarks, context length or prices were published.
src: Meituan launches LongCat-2.5 multimodal AI model for extended coding tasks

releases.t: Agility's Digit passes 100,000 totes at a GXO warehouse
releases.n: Agility Robotics said on 2 Nov that its Digit humanoid has moved more than 100,000 totes at GXO's Georgia site since June 2024, a company figure; GXO signed for two more US sites, in Statesville, North Carolina and Lebanon, Tennessee, starting in early 2027. No unit counts were given.
src: Agility Robotics says more than 30 companies considering Digit humanoid robot

releases.t: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx; the best model scores 12%
releases.n: SemiAnalysis published GDPx on 2 Nov, a benchmark of long agentic tasks in 11 domains, scored pass@1 over three attempts with tasks of up to eight hours. Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) leads at 12.0%, ahead of Gemini 4 Carbon (Google) at 10.9% and GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI) at 9.6%; finance and legal tasks score near zero.
src: SemiAnalysis unveils GDPx benchmark, and the best AI model scores 12%

releases.t: AMD ships MI450 and Helios; data-centre sales nearly double
releases.n: Q3 revenue $13.4 billion, data centre $8.5 billion (+97%); MI450 launched, Helios racks in use, ROCm 10 released.
src: AMD reports third quarter 2026 financial results

releases.t: Google DeepMind gives its Antigravity agent cheminformatics skills
releases.n: RDKit-based skills; the demo curated 568 compounds and benchmarked models across four readouts in about an hour.

releases.t: Baidu launches Apollo World driving simulator
releases.n: Up to 100,000 km of simulated driving a day; trains the Apollo Go robotaxi fleet.
src: China's Baidu launches AI model simulating road environment for robotaxis

releases.t: OpenAI pipeline finds 948 unique Linux kernel privilege-escalation exploits
releases.n: About 2.8 million lines scanned; 1,169 working exploits, 948 unique; $1,213,430 in API credits, about $1,279 each; 61 patched upstream.
src: OpenAI pipeline finds 948 Linux kernel privilege escalation flaws

releases.t: Cognition releases SWE-2 Flash coding model
releases.n: 276B parameters, 12B active; about 200 tokens a second; a fifth of SWE-2's price; FrontierCode 2.0 24.0; weights withheld.
No parameter count or benchmarks published; weights to follow with a safety-testing report.
src: Tencent releases new AI model, pledges safeguards against cyberattack use

releases.t: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber to vetted defenders
releases.n: Rated Critical for cybersecurity; ExploitGym 48.45% against GPT-6 Astra's 42.43%; working exploits for 948 of 1,724 reproduced Linux kernel flaws. [67, 68]

releases.t: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model
releases.n: Clips up to 15 seconds, up to 4K after upscaling, $0.07 a second at 720p, 30% below Omni 1.1. [69]
src: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: fast and cost-effective with longer clips

releases.t: Meta adds real-time voice and avatars to Muse
releases.n: US rollout on mobile, web and Mac; hundreds of voices; no latency figures published. [70]
src: Introducing Muse AI voice and expressive avatars

releases.t: Meta ships specialised Muse models with Active Memory
releases.n: Internal evals: Personal Superintelligence Index 47% (from 38%), Active Memory 90% (from 76%), 2.4x less forgetting. [69]
src: Bringing specialized models to Muse and Meta AI

releases.n: 594B total, 17B active; SWE-Bench Pro v2 (Hard) 86.3%; $0.30/$1.00 per M tokens; weights under Apache 2.0 promised. [71, 72]

releases.t: METR assesses AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic
releases.n: Internal progress about 1.9x faster than before Oct 2025 (95% interval 1.5–2.8); about 80% attributed to AI. [73]
src: AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic: an independent assessment
